stations.say: Did my plan change the board?

stations.title: Search board
stations.text: One list that every team works from.

stations.title: Your functions
tasks: What if, on a new list

captions: A long search, and Ailsa keeps the squares still to search on the board.
Today a plan on the laptop changes the real board, and a searched square stays on it.
You write functions that either change the board or give back a new list, never both.
Now plans come back as new lists, and only real changes reach the board.
Second names, copies, and lists that change while a loop goes through them.
